name: Peatland Restoration Grant

funder.name: Natural Resources Wales (National Peatland Action Programme)

summary: Capital grants for peatland restoration in Wales, covering on-the-ground works plus surveys and design, for projects running April 2027 to March 2028. Open to individuals and organisations that can show peatland restoration experience or technical support.
reporting: Applicants must spend and claim all eligible costs by 31 March 2028; the final claim date will be 31 March 2028.

eligibility.rule: Has delivered a peatland project in the last decade or has support from an experienced partner or contractor
Does not seek revenue costs, off-priority restoration, unlinked monitoring or unsupported tree clearance
Is not a mitigation or compensation project for peatland damage elsewhere
Does not receive this grant alongside Welsh Government land management funding for the same outcomes
Addresses one or more National Peatland Action Programme priorities

documents: Evidence of peatland restoration experience or confirmed technical support
Project plan and cost breakdown on the NRW template
Last 3 months of bank statements and certified ID (individuals)
Signed agreements with formal delivery partners

calls.label: Application round for 2027-28 projects

status.quote: We're accepting applications from 1 September 2026. You must apply by 23:59 on 30 November 2026.

deadline.quote: You must apply by 23:59 on 30 November 2026.

calls.note: Decisions are aimed to be given by March 2027; grantees must spend and claim all eligible costs by 31 March 2028.

applicant_types.quote: Individuals Public sector organisations Registered charities Universities, other higher education institutions and research institutes Third sector organisations Private sector organisations

geography.quote: The peatland must also be in Wales.

access.quote: You'll need a reference number to start your grant application.

window.quote: We're accepting applications from 1 September 2026. You must apply by 23:59 on 30 November 2026.

amount.quote: You can apply for between £10,000 and £250,000 in funding.

co_finance_required.quote: You can ask for up to 100% of your project costs.

reporting.quote: Applicants must spend and claim all eligible costs by 31 March 2028. Any unspent funds may not be rolled into the subsequent financial year. The final claim date will be 31 March 2028.

effort.quote: You'll need a reference number to start your grant application. Get your reference number.
You must apply by 23:59 on 30 November 2026.

eligibility.quote: Evidence of having delivered at least one peatland restoration project in the last decade Confirmation of technical support from a partner who has experience of delivering peatland restoration on the ground, and can provide appropriate technical support at cost Confirmation of technical support from a contractor with proven experience

Revenue costs (costs not relating to capital delivery) Capital restoration that does not deliver the NPAP restoration priorities Survey or monitoring not linked to capital restoration works proposed Clearance of trees/scrub where no other sustainable management action such as changes to hydrology or grazing are also implemented
Funding cannot be used towards any mitigation or compensation projects for damage to peatlands elsewhere.

This funding cannot be received alongside other Welsh Government funded land management schemes to achieve the same outcomes, such as the Sustainable Farming Scheme (SFS) and it's predecessor schemes.
All projects will need to address one or more of the National Peatland Action Programme priorities:

documents.quote: Lead applicants must provide at least one of the following: Evidence of having delivered at least one peatland restoration project in the last decade
We will ask you to upload the following: Your completed project plan and breakdown of project costs using our template
If you are applying as a third sector organisation you will need to upload your governing documents
last 3 months bank statements and a certified copy of your passport
If you have formal delivery partners, you must upload a copy of any signed agreement with them
